description: Defines the PlatformManager class responsible for platform-specific operations such as ARP monitoring, CMDU message handling, WLAN parameter checks, and socket management within the prplMesh agent. It includes method declarations, member variables, and external dependencies relevant to platform management in a network device context.

classes.name: PlatformManager
classes.description: Manages platform-specific network operations, including ARP monitoring, CMDU message exchange, WLAN parameter management, and socket connections within the prplMesh agent.

methods.name: query_db
methods.description: Queries platform parameters such as 'is_master', 'is_gateway', and 'is_onboarding' via BPL.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the platform manager, initializing necessary components.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the platform manager, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: handle_connected
methods.description: Handles new client connections to the CMDU server.

methods.name: handle_disconnected
methods.description: Handles client disconnections from the CMDU server.

methods.name: send_cmdu_to_agent_safe
methods.description: Safely sends a CMDU message to the agent.

methods.name: send_cmdu
methods.description: Sends a CMDU message over a socket.

methods.name: load_iface_params
methods.description: Loads interface parameters based on interface name and ARP source type.

methods.name: bridge_iface_from_mac
methods.description: Returns bridge interface name from MAC address.

methods.name: check_wlan_params_changed
methods.description: Checks if WLAN parameters have changed and notifies slaves if needed.
